about: COP's lanes. A lane is one kind of item from one program. Its record counts what it flagged and, once Verdict scores them, how many a second source confirmed, how many were withdrawn and how many stayed unconfirmed. Counts only: no rate or skill figure before 30 independently scored items. A record describes how a measurement has behaved; it is not a warning and gives no likelihood to any item.

lanes.name: Blackout's internet outages and single-source dips, read through COP's triage

tests.background: Triage's base rates from COP's archived days (tools/triage_rates.py).
